name: readme-examples
//: The README's example budgets files, extracted by examples.py, laid out as the README describes and validated by the built binary. Behind its own edge: only the README, the binary or this project select it.

options.command: uv run --frozen --no-sync ruff format --quiet --config tools/readme/ruff.toml tools/readme
uv run --frozen --no-sync ruff format --quiet --check --config tools/readme/ruff.toml tools/readme
uv run --frozen --no-sync ruff check --quiet --config tools/readme/ruff.toml tools/readme
